description: This file provides database connection management functions for MongoDB using Mongoose, including establishing connections, retrieving database and collection objects, and checking connection status.

methods.name: connectDB
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB using environment variables for configuration, sets connection options, and logs connection events.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Returns the native MongoDB database object from the current Mongoose connection, establishing a connection if necessary.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDB collection by name or from a list of candidate names, with fallback to the first candidate if none exist.

methods.name: isDbConnected
methods.description: Checks if Mongoose is currently connected to the database.
